purpose: Continue the 12345->14523 internet scan, record current NIST Rh III topology limitations around the theoretical 77596-cm^-1 candidate, evaluate the NS 44049 same-system neighborhood, and preserve authoritative technical identifier collisions as Worldshepherd controls.

source_ingestion_policy.rule: Every substantive unique publication, authoritative dataset, advisory, or information item discovered during the inquiry receives a Worldshepherd use or an explicit negative-control role.
source_ingestion_policy.duplicates: Duplicate mirrors, derivative copies, repeated records, and alternate landing pages are provenance aliases and are not independent evidence.
source_ingestion_policy.search_noise: Search co-occurrence, CVE numbers, CAS numbers, advisory IDs, serial numbers, file boundaries, and similar identifiers are not Glob evidence unless an independently verified physical quantity in a declared unit family is established.

sources.title: NIST Atomic Spectra Database holdings — rhodium levels and lines
sources.authority: National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.note: Current NIST ASD holdings report 196 Rh III energy levels and 73 Rh III spectral lines; the 73 Rh III line records presently have zero level designations and zero transition-probability entries. Use this as a topology-coverage limitation when evaluating the historical theoretical 77596-cm^-1 Rh III candidate.

sources.title: CVE-2025-60075
sources.note: Use as a security-feed/identifier negative-control exemplar. The 60075 equality is a CVE identifier and carries zero physical Glob evidence weight. It is not evidence that Worldshepherd uses or is affected by the named WordPress plugin.

sources.title: NIST Chemistry WebBook — 3,4-Dimethoxyphenylacethydrazide
sources.authority: National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.note: The compound carries CAS Registry Number 60075-23-2. Use this as an authoritative chemical-identifier control demonstrating that the target digits can occur in scientific databases without representing a measured energy or frequency.

evidence_updates.claims_boundary: 60075 is the numeric component of a CVE identifier; it is not a physical quantity.
60075 is embedded in CAS 60075-23-2; it is not a spectroscopy value.

information_updates.finding: Current NIST ASD holds 196 Rh III levels and 73 Rh III lines, but the Rh III line holdings currently contain no level designations. The historical 77596-cm^-1 theoretical Rh III level therefore cannot be converted into a current-NIST same-endpoint or Ritz P2 claim using the present line-designation holdings alone.
information_updates.claims_boundary: Absence of current level-designated line topology is a data-coverage limitation, not evidence against the historical calculated level itself.

information_updates.finding: The NIST NS diatomic-constants table lists H 2Pi_i Te=(44049) cm^-1 and multiple neighboring electronic states/band origins. Screening the immediate 44940->44049 orbit against that same NS table did not identify 44940 as a same-system term or band-origin match within the predeclared 1 cm^-1 tolerance; no P2 upgrade is made.
information_updates.claims_boundary: 44049 remains P1. The nearby I->X band origin 44050.1 cm^-1 is 1.1 cm^-1 from 44049 and lies just outside the current 1 cm^-1 screening tolerance; tolerance is not widened post hoc.

information_updates.finding: The same generated target 60075 independently occurs in two authoritative NIST contexts as unrelated identifiers: CVE-2025-60075 and CAS 60075-23-2. This is a useful empirical demonstration of collision multiplicity in technical corpora.
information_updates.claims_boundary: Repeated authoritative-database occurrence does not increase physical evidence when all occurrences are identifiers rather than measured quantities.
